district_name: Lake Region Union High School District

jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(6)(G) inventory: Lake Region Union High School District, a union high school district (16 V.S.A. section 748) in the Orleans Central Supervisory Union (member towns: Albany, Barton, Brownington, Glover, Irasburg, Westmore, plus the former Barton and Orleans ISD areas within Barton). Operates grades 9-12. A merger vote with the elementary-middle district is scheduled November 3, 2026 -- pending, not the current structure.

board.org_name: Lake Region Union High School Board

sources.note: Lake Region Union High School District: eleven directors elected by the whole district electorate at a single floor annual meeting with seats allocated by residency (16 V.S.A. section 748 modified at-large; allocation as published in the 2023-2024 Annual Report: Albany 1, Barton 3, Brownington 1, Glover 1, Irasburg 2, Orleans 2, Westmore 1). Only the three members whose current terms are established by a fetched official document are minted; the remaining seats were HELD pending the district's annual-meeting records (White, Kinsley, Piette and Michiewicz were resolved by the March 18, 2026 minutes on 2026-10-26; Coe, Postman, Maxwell and a possible 11th seat remain held)026 roster table and the March 18, 2026 annual meeting minutes. David Blodgett (Orleans, re-elected 2025) has departed; Sarah Kinsley appears in his place by an undocumented route. Lake Region Union High School District 2023-2024 Annual Report (official, via OCSU): "The Lake Region Union High School Board is made up of 11 members from the sending towns of Albany, Barton, Brownington, Glover, Irasburg and Westmore," with the last full roster and term expirations (allocation: Albany 1, Barton 3, Brownington 1, Glover 1, Irasburg 2, Orleans 2, Westmore 1).

LRUHS board packet, December 2, 2024 (official, via OCSU): warning for the March 19, 2025 annual meeting, Article 6 -- elect four directors (former Barton ISD, Albany, Glover, former Orleans ISD) for three-year terms from the district's legal voters at a single floor meeting; the packet annotates the seats with the sitting members Cahill, Carbonetti, Racine, Blodgett. The March 23, 2026 reorganization minutes (April 6, 2026 packet) seat ten members with Carbonetti as Chair.

Lake Region Union High School District annual meeting minutes, March 18, 2026 (official; hosted on the Orleans Central SU site and supplied by Lisa Worden, OCSU, on 2026-10-26 after she unblocked the file's view). Article 6 (floor meeting; slate motion carried, clerk to cast one ballot for each): Bernard White, Jr. (former Barton Incorporated SD seat) elected to a three-year term; Sarah Kinsley (Irasburg) to a three-year term; Jerry Piette (Irasburg) to a one-year term; Linda Michiewicz (Westmore) to a three-year term. Article 4 introductions name the sitting board. The Coe, Postman and Maxwell seats were not before this meeting and remain HELD (their current terms are still not established by a fetched official document), as does the possible 11th seat.

directors.name: Richard Carbonetti
directors.note: Albany seat; elected March 19, 2025 to a three-year term (2025 warning annotation). Board Chair per the March 23, 2026 reorganization minutes.

directors.name: Gerry Cahill
directors.note: Former Barton ISD seat; elected March 19, 2025 to a three-year term (2025 warning annotation). Same person as the Barton justice of the peace record.

directors.name: Korrina Skorker
directors.note: Glover seat; elected March 19, 2025 to a three-year term, succeeding Jason Racine (2025 warning annotation). Minutes also print "Corrina Skorker"; the warning annotation's Korrina governs.

directors.name: Bernard White, Jr.
directors.note: Former Barton Incorporated School District seat; elected March 18, 2026 to a three-year term (annual meeting minutes, Article 6A; the slate motion names him 'Bernie White').

directors.name: Sarah Kinsley
directors.note: Irasburg seat; elected March 18, 2026 to a three-year term (annual meeting minutes, Article 6B).

directors.name: Jerry Piette
directors.note: Irasburg seat; elected March 18, 2026 to a one-year term (annual meeting minutes, Article 6C).

directors.name: Linda Michiewicz
directors.note: Westmore seat; elected March 18, 2026 to a three-year term (annual meeting minutes, Article 6D). The build's held list spelled the surname 'Michniewicz'; the signed minutes' spelling is followed.
